NOASSERTION.note: No separate public license is declared for first-party generated cues.

licenseScope: License fields describe original source material. Processing and normalization records do not declare a separate project-wide license for newly authored contributions.
conversion: Separate levelled exports per playback context. Audited chosen take, mono 44.1kHz/160kbps MP3; loudness and encoding correction baked into each file at unity game master. No runtime per-clip gain, take or source rotation. Legacy UI cues retain their original fixed 0.29 level. Subsequent user-reviewed edits are recorded in the project-relative audio/reviewed-ranges.json. Normalization records describe the pre-review baseline; assetSha256 and referenceGameOutputStrongest50msRmsDbFS describe the current edited output.
takeNumbering: one-based; range refers to the recording field; derived edits include their original-source processingRecipe
